app/api/analytics/recently-viewed/route..name: Recently viewed products
app/api/analytics/recently-viewed/route..description: Returns the list of products a customer or visitor looked at recently.

app/api/analytics/track-view/route.ts.name: Record product view
app/api/analytics/track-view/route.ts.description: Records that a customer or visitor has viewed a specific product.

app/api/bespoke/route.ts.name: Bespoke enquiry form
app/api/bespoke/route.ts.description: Saves a custom-jewellery enquiry with budget, style preferences and inspiration files, then emails the team.

app/api/cart/[id]/route.ts.name: Single cart item
app/api/cart/[id]/route.ts.description: Updates the quantity of a cart item or removes it from the cart.

app/api/cart/route.ts.name: Shopping cart
app/api/cart/route.ts.description: Returns the customer's cart, adds a configured product to it, or clears it entirely.

app/api/checkout/route.ts.name: Start checkout
app/api/checkout/route.ts.description: Creates an order, opens a Stripe payment page and clears the cart.

app/api/inventory/route.ts.name: Stock check
app/api/inventory/route.ts.description: Returns the current stock level for a product or checks whether a specific variant is available.

app/api/orders/[id]/route.ts.name: Single order details
app/api/orders/[id]/route.ts.description: Returns the full details of one of the customer's orders.

app/api/orders/route.ts.name: Order history
app/api/orders/route.ts.description: Lists all orders placed by the signed-in customer.

app/api/products/route.ts.name: Product catalogue
app/api/products/route.ts.description: Searches and filters the jewellery catalogue from the content system.

app/api/waitlist/route.ts.name: Waitlist sign-up
app/api/waitlist/route.ts.description: Adds an email address to the Privé collection waitlist and notifies the team.

app/api/wishlist/route.ts.name: Customer wishlist
app/api/wishlist/route.ts.description: Returns, adds to, or removes products from the customer's saved wishlist.

GET /api/analytics/recently-viewed.name: List recently viewed
GET /api/analytics/recently-viewed.description: Returns the products a customer or visitor browsed most recently.

POST /api/analytics/track-view.name: Record a product view
POST /api/analytics/track-view.description: Logs that a customer or visitor has just looked at a product page.

POST /api/bespoke.name: Submit bespoke enquiry
POST /api/bespoke.description: Saves a custom-jewellery request with budget, style and stone preferences, then emails the team.

PUT /api/cart/[id].name: Change item quantity
PUT /api/cart/[id].description: Updates how many of a particular item are in the customer's cart.

DELETE /api/cart/[id].name: Remove cart item
DELETE /api/cart/[id].description: Takes a single item out of the customer's shopping cart.

GET /api/cart.name: View cart
GET /api/cart.description: Returns every item currently in the signed-in customer's cart.

POST /api/cart.name: Add to cart
POST /api/cart.description: Puts a configured jewellery piece into the customer's shopping cart.

DELETE /api/cart.name: Clear cart
DELETE /api/cart.description: Removes all items from the customer's shopping cart at once.

POST /api/checkout.name: Begin payment
POST /api/checkout.description: Creates an order record, opens a Stripe payment page and empties the cart.

GET /api/inventory.name: Check stock
GET /api/inventory.description: Returns the stock level for a product or whether a chosen variant is in stock.

GET /api/orders/[id].name: View order details
GET /api/orders/[id].description: Returns the full breakdown of a single order the customer placed.

GET /api/orders.name: List past orders
GET /api/orders.description: Returns every order the signed-in customer has placed, newest first.

GET /api/products.name: Browse products
GET /api/products.description: Searches and filters the jewellery catalogue and returns matching pieces.

POST /api/waitlist.name: Join the waitlist
POST /api/waitlist.description: Saves an email to the Privé collection waitlist and sends the team a notification.

GET /api/wishlist.name: View wishlist
GET /api/wishlist.description: Returns all products the signed-in customer has saved to their wishlist.

POST /api/wishlist.name: Save to wishlist
POST /api/wishlist.description: Adds a product to the signed-in customer's wishlist.

DELETE /api/wishlist.name: Remove from wishlist
DELETE /api/wishlist.description: Takes a product off the signed-in customer's wishlist.
